description: SNOB-5G provides measurements from an outdoor millimetre-wave backhaul network of three Metnet 60G nodes. The Instituto de Telecomunicações research team collected multilayer metrics for fixed modulation and coding modes and automatic mode adjustment. The README describes fifteen-minute normal and continuously blocked experiments, plus five-minute experiments with temporary obstruction by people. The GitHub root exposes a complete CSV dataset and a smaller automatic-mode CSV. The linked Zenodo 1.0 archive declares CC BY 4.0 and provides free access; GitHub itself has no licence file. This licence statement is therefore attributed to the archived release. The testbed is in Portugal according to the article, and no general geographic coverage is implied. The root documentation does not establish a common sampling interval across all metrics. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating blockage and recovery behaviour in wireless backhaul simulations, including comparisons with platform-ns-3. These observations cover a small experimental topology; they do not establish performance across all 5G deployments.
